response.answer: This case study explains how an early, hackathon-winning AI prototype and follow-up UX research (87% would use again) informed a shift from isolated GPTs to reusable, workflow-driven platform foundations. The core insight is a “middle layer” (MCP-style connectors, permissions, and orchestration) that lets models reach the right tools and context while keeping humans in control. Execution focused on mapping recurring patterns, building agent-based and retrieval workflows, and translating architecture into product language, leading to shared platform vocabulary, faster reuse, and an agentic foundation; specific diagrams and workflow artifacts are noted but not publicly shown yet.
